questions.prompt: Which of these are Greek gods, not Roman ones?
questions.fact: The Romans took over most of the Greek gods and renamed them. Hermes became Mercury and Ares became Mars.

questions.prompt: Which of these were Viking homelands?
questions.fact: Iceland was settled by Vikings from Norway in the 870s, but the raids set out from Scandinavia itself.

questions.prompt: How many calories are in one gram of fat?
questions.fact: Nine, more than twice the four in a gram of sugar or protein.

questions.prompt: How many years did Michelangelo spend painting the Sistine Chapel ceiling?
questions.fact: Four years, 1508 to 1512, mostly standing up and painting above his head.

questions.prompt: What is the smallest country in the world?
questions.hint: It sits entirely inside a capital city.
questions.fact: Vatican City covers less than half a square kilometre, smaller than many city parks.

questions.prompt: Which band made the album Rumours?
questions.fact: Rumours was made in 1976 while two couples in the band were breaking up.
